summary: 'I don't understand' is UNDERSTAND (an index finger flicking up at the forehead) with a head shake, or NOT UNDERSTAND. The head shake alone can do the negating.
steps: Sign UNDERSTAND: a fist at the side of the forehead flicks the index finger up.
Shake your head while you sign it. That negates it.
Keep eye contact and a slightly questioning face so the other person knows to repeat.
mistakes: Nodding along instead. Nodding when you're lost wastes everyone's time; this phrase is polite and expected.
